scales.question: How does the human commons spine connect heritage, daily life and AI-era public value?
Where do the three key areas exchange ordinary routes, care and maintenance?
Can each node show ordinary entry, staffed help and a withdrawable AI edge together?
Can the public interface separate explanation, consent, pause, appeal and maintenance retreat?
scales.evidence: relative interface logic, pending professional review

scales.question: Can a paper receipt, human takeover and removable component be read at handoff?

alternatives.label: AI showcase spine
alternatives.reason: A device-first public spine makes the machine interface the visible default and pushes ordinary, low-digital and staffed routes into a secondary condition.
alternatives.spatial_move: one continuous display and test strip owns the public frontage

alternatives.label: three isolated AI rooms
alternatives.reason: Separate rooms can contain experiments but leave cross-node maintenance, public appeal and retention of ordinary assets without one readable handoff.
alternatives.ordinary_return: ordinary route retained, shared closeout unclear
alternatives.spatial_move: three enclosed test rooms with independent notices and no common public receipt

alternatives.label: human commons spine plus reversible service islands
alternatives.reason: Ordinary passage, staffed explanation, non-digital equivalence and public assets remain first-class while AI components stay bounded, removable and independently reviewable.
alternatives.ordinary_return: ordinary, accessible, staffed and paper routes remain protected
alternatives.spatial_move: one human commons spine, three node interfaces and removable AI service islands

nodes.role: staffed explanation, observation and bounded test edge
nodes.resident_protection: ordinary entrance, accessible bypass and human takeover remain visible

nodes.role: daily service, learning and screen-free public interface
nodes.resident_protection: paper, voice and staffed routes do not require a data call

nodes.role: cultural explanation, public record and maintenance handoff
nodes.resident_protection: ordinary passage, quiet retreat and appeal remain open

rights_matrix.ordinary_service: walk, staffed help and physical wayfinding remain available
paper, voice and face-to-face service can complete the task
rights_matrix.service_condition: no account or data call is a precondition

rights_matrix.ordinary_service: continuous accessible route and human assistance
rights_matrix.service_condition: no longer or less safe substitute

rights_matrix.ordinary_service: purpose, refusal, appeal and withdrawal are readable
public passage, service and minimal records remain after withdrawal
rights_matrix.failure_action: retain asset, clear unneeded data and stop
